module: Traffic telemetry tracker. It answers the question "how much traffic is actually used": it opens the `trafficActive` activity when traffic starts and closes it when it stops, attaching the peak of active vehicles. Depends on `telemetry_core` and is only used for statistics collection, not for gameplay.
notes: The vehicle count is deliberately not read when traffic starts or stops: those hooks arrive one frame after the first or last vehicle, when the count is not yet stable. Only the peak (`peakAmount`) is kept via onTrafficAmountChanged.
The activity is also closed on onClientEndMission, onExit and onExtensionUnloaded, because traffic does not always stop cleanly on a level change and a Lua reload does not trigger onExit.
The extension sets itself to manual unload (`setExtensionUnloadMode(M, "manual")`) on load.

dependencies.desc: Extensions to load before this one: `{'telemetry_core'}`.

onTrafficStarted.desc: Hook called when traffic starts. Resets the peak to 0 and opens the `trafficActive` activity with the current level (`getCurrentLevelIdentifier()` or "unknown").

onTrafficStopped.desc: Hook called when traffic stops. Does nothing if traffic was not running; otherwise closes the `trafficActive` activity with `peakAmount`.

onTrafficAmountChanged.desc: Hook called whenever vehicles enter or leave the traffic pool. Keeps only the maximum, without creating an event.

onClientEndMission.desc: Hook called at the end of the mission/level on the client side. Closes the traffic activity if it is open (same code as onTrafficStopped).

onExit.desc: Hook called when the game exits. Alias of onClientEndMission: closes the traffic activity.

onExtensionUnloaded.desc: Hook called when the extension is unloaded (for example on a Lua reload, which does not go through onExit). Closes the traffic activity.

onExtensionLoaded.desc: Hook called when the extension loads. Sets the extension to manual unload.
